svg.title: Orthonym: Deterministic structure-to-IUPAC names, each checked by an OPSIN round trip. A bench with a typewriter, a proofreader and a stamp. The typewriter copies a structure from its copy holder and types the name on a card; the card slides under the OPSIN reader, whose screen shows the structure it rebuilt from the name; a comparator needle swings to its top mark when the two structures are the same; the stamp prints the tier the name earned, and the card is filed in a tray. It loops over ethanol (PIN), trans-cyclohexane-1,4-diol (fallback), cis-decahydronaphthalene (best effort) and uranium trioxide, which gets no name.
